::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [13 June 1879]  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: Eng. lett. d. 495 f107[^1]
:::

[Signora Villari](people/person_1444.qmd)’s graceful story has been safely received, and shall be commenced in January 1880[^2]

C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Card printed on one side Foreign post card addressed to 'Italy/ Signora Linda Villari/932 Via Pinti/Florence' and postmarked 'Winchester/JU 13/79'.
[^2]: Villari's 'The Angel of Viareggio: A Tale of Child-Life in Italy' began in *MP* ns 31 (January 1880) and ran until July.
